The Roughneck Gorilla Pro-Grip Utility Bar is a robust 15" (376mm) wrecking bar designed for demanding prying, lifting, and nail removal tasks. Crafted from drop-forged, heat-treated and hardened carbon steel with a flat shaft, it offers exceptional strength and durability for builders and carpenters on demolition or renovation projects. A powder-coated finish ensures the bar is rust and corrosion-resistant, extending its lifespan. Featuring a high-grip design for secure handling and three integrated bevelled nail removers, this utility bar efficiently extracts embedded fasteners and tackles tight fixings with ease, providing reliable performance on site.
b: Built for Tough Prying & Lifting Tasks
